# Kalkan — Full Product Reference

Last verified: 2026-08-24

## Identity
- Product: Kalkan
- Product type: unwanted-call blocking and caller identification application
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17.6 or later
- App Store ID: 6759873828
- Bundle ID: com.kalkan.website.kalkan
- App Store URL: https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/kalkan-caller-id-block/id6759873828
- Public version: 1.0.6 (110), released 2026-08-19 in Türkiye time
- Languages: Turkish and English
- Primary category: Utilities; secondary category: Productivity
- Website: https://kalkan.website/
- Contact: info@kalkan.website

## Purpose
Kalkan helps iPhone users reduce interruptions from known unwanted callers and understand who may be calling when an institutional or categorized number exists in Kalkan's identification dataset. The product uses Apple's Call Directory architecture. It is not a telecommunications carrier, does not intercept calls, and does not perform real-time call-audio analysis.

## Architecture and call-time behavior
Kalkan downloads separate General identification and exact-blocking datasets over HTTPS. It validates and normalizes phone numbers, removes duplicates, filters blocked numbers out of identification output, and writes complete on-device artifacts shared with its Call Directory Extension. If the user has Extra access, pattern-based Extra blocking output is merged into the final blocking data. Blocking entries are loaded before identification entries and have precedence for overlaps. Kalkan then requests an iOS Call Directory reload. During an incoming call, iOS—not a continuously running Kalkan process—checks the number against the loaded Call Directory data.

The Call Directory payload is a deterministic full source of truth rather than an incremental database. General Protection is isolated from Extra Protection: Extra failure or entitlement loss must not disable General.

## Features

### General Protection — free
- Exact-number blocking for known unwanted numbers.
- Caller identification for numbers in the identification dataset, including reviewed institutional labels.
- General data download, compilation, application and refresh.
- Independent from Premium and Extra Protection.
- Core incoming-call matching can continue offline after data is loaded.

### Extra Protection — Premium
- Optional blocking derived from suspicious number patterns and extended ranges.
- Only Extra Protection is gated by Kalkan Premium or durable grandfathered access from the one-time migration policy.
- General Protection and caller identification remain available without Premium.
- Entitlement loss removes Extra and safely rebuilds General-only Call Directory state when usable General artifacts exist.

### Kalkan Premium
- Product ID: com.kalkan.website.kalkan.premium.yearly
- Type: yearly auto-renewable subscription
- Storefront availability: Türkiye for the documented release
- Türkiye price configured for the release: TRY 99.90 per year
- Introductory offer: three months free for eligible Apple accounts
- StoreKit 2 is used for verified purchase, entitlement updates, restore purchases and Apple's subscription-management flow.
- The application reads localized price and offer eligibility from StoreKit rather than treating website text as an entitlement source.

### Caller identification
- iOS displays a Kalkan label when the incoming number matches the loaded identification dataset.
- Identification data is static/preloaded at call time; there is no remote lookup during the ringing call.
- A label is informational. It does not cryptographically authenticate the caller, guarantee safety, or prevent caller-ID spoofing.

### Suspicious-number reporting
- The in-app reporting form submits to the Kalkan backend and supports spam, fraud and other/investigation use cases.
- The iOS Communication Reporting extension uses Apple's IdentityLookup system-managed handoff for preset categories.
- In the system extension, the user must complete Apple's Done/checkmark step; Kalkan does not claim backend receipt before that step.
- Submitted numbers are moderation inputs. They are not automatically approved, blocked or published to production datasets.

### Announcements and release notes
- The Home interface provides General and Updates content.
- Remote content is cached-first and merged with permanent localized fallback content.
- The installed-version release note remains available even when the remote feed is unavailable.
- Announcement failure is non-blocking and does not change Call Directory or protection behavior.

### Protection-data update reminders
- Offered only after a successful user-triggered Home data update.
- User-selectable intervals: one month, three months, six months or one year.
- Implemented as local notifications scheduled from the actual last successful update date.
- The feature does not silently update the app binary, promise continuous background execution, or request notification permission without explicit enable intent.

### Focus Setup Assistant
- Free guidance for Apple Focus scenarios: Work, Weekend and Project.
- Explains people, schedules, repeated calls and emergency exceptions.
- Stores only the selected scenario/completion marker locally.
- Does not access Contacts, read Focus configuration, change iOS settings, silence calls directly, decline calls or send automatic replies.

### Settings and support
- Protection status and setup/recovery guidance.
- Manual protection-data refresh.
- Premium purchase, restore and manage-subscription actions.
- Reminder interval settings.
- Support, number-removal and allowlist request forms where available.
- Privacy, terms and product information links.

## Setup
1. Install Kalkan from the App Store.
2. Open the app and complete General Protection data preparation.
3. Open iOS Settings > Apps > Phone > Call Blocking & Identification.
4. Enable Kalkan.
5. Return to Kalkan and confirm that protection is active.
6. Optionally enable Kalkan under SMS/Call Reporting in iOS Phone settings for the system reporting extension.
7. Use the Home update action regularly to refresh protection data.

## Update semantics
- Passive/background refresh performs heavy apply/reload work only when meaningful data changed.
- A manual Home refresh can force reapplication from usable cached artifacts and request a Call Directory reload even when the server reports no changed version.
- Repeated Home update taps are single-flight to avoid overlapping apply operations.
- Failed, cancelled, partial or reload-failed updates do not create a new reminder date.

## Privacy
- Kalkan does not request Contacts access for its protection or Focus guidance.
- Kalkan does not read the user's address book.
- Kalkan does not read or store the user's call history.
- Kalkan does not analyze call audio or conversation content.
- Call blocking and identification matching happen through on-device iOS Call Directory data.
- A user explicitly submitting a report sends the reported number and report metadata required for moderation.

## Limitations
- Kalkan cannot guarantee detection of every new, unknown or spoofed number.
- iOS does not allow this product to perform unrestricted real-time call analysis.
- Data must be downloaded and Kalkan must be enabled in iOS settings before protection can work.
- An institutional label describes the reviewed dataset entry, not proof that the current caller is genuine.
- Internet is needed for fresh datasets, report submission, announcements and StoreKit state refresh. Already-loaded core Call Directory matching can work offline.
- Kalkan does not automatically update its App Store binary; update reminders concern protection data.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is Kalkan free?
General Protection, basic caller identification, General data updates, reporting, announcements, settings and General onboarding are free. Only Extra Protection requires Kalkan Premium or valid grandfathered access.

### Does Kalkan block every unwanted call?
No. iOS can only block or identify numbers represented in the loaded data. New, unlisted or spoofed numbers may pass through.

### Does Kalkan run continuously in the background?
No. Kalkan prepares datasets and requests a Call Directory reload. iOS performs the incoming-call match.

### Does Kalkan access contacts or call history?
No. The documented production behavior does not access contacts or call history.

### What is the difference between General and Extra Protection?
General Protection uses exact-number blocking and identification lists. Extra Protection adds blocking expanded from suspicious number patterns and is the only Premium-gated protection layer.

### Does reporting a number block it immediately?
No. Reporting, human/automated moderation, approval and dataset publication are separate stages.

### Can Kalkan verify that a caller is genuine?
No. A label is an informational dataset match and cannot eliminate caller-ID spoofing.

### When should protection data be updated?
Use the Home update action regularly. Optional reminders can be scheduled for 1, 3, 6 or 12 months after the last successful manual update.
